decisions.rationale: Reject because the candidate collapses genuinely different hotel-quality thresholds, including at least 3 stars, 4 stars, 4.5 stars, and general high-review language, into one broad 3-star floor plus ranking rule. These are not true aliases and should not be merged merely because they share the hotel-rating family.

decisions.boundary_condition: Applies only to hotel or lodging quality-rating filters, including property-star ratings or customer-review ratings; does not apply to destination, dates, amenities, price, flights, restaurants, or activities.
decisions.condition: When searching for hotels and no explicit current-trip hotel rating or review threshold has been provided.
decisions.default_action: Filter or prioritize hotel options with ratings of 3.5 stars or better; if a range is required, use 3.5 to 5 stars.
decisions.exception_condition: If the current request states a different rating threshold or range, accepts a lower or unrated property for budget, availability, or location reasons, or names a specific property, follow the current request instead.
decisions.name: Prefer hotels rated at least 3.5 stars
decisions.rationale: Keep because the evidence consistently supports a reusable 3.5-star-or-better hotel rating threshold, scoped to lodging quality filters and overridden by explicit current-trip instructions.

decisions.boundary_condition: Applies only to hotel property-star or customer-review rating thresholds; does not imply destination, dates, price level, location type, amenities, or a five-star luxury requirement.
decisions.condition: When searching for hotels and no explicit current-trip hotel rating or review threshold has been provided.
decisions.default_action: Filter or prioritize hotels with property-star ratings of at least 4 stars or customer-review scores around 4.0 or higher.
decisions.exception_condition: If the current request gives a different threshold or range, such as 3 to 4 stars, asks to broaden for budget or availability, or names a specific property, follow that explicit instruction instead.
decisions.name: Prefer hotels rated at least 4 stars
decisions.rationale: Keep as a distinct 4-star-or-better hotel quality threshold. The evidence is mostly aligned around 4-star or 4-plus ratings; the contrasting 3-to-4 example is handled as an explicit-current-request exception rather than merged with lower-threshold policies.
